requirements.detail: Freeze the updated PDF as the working source, identify its detailed S6B/S12B additions, and record all S15 decisions. Keep the earlier PDF as historical context only. Source: pp1-29. Evidence: `planning/landing-p0/source-manifest.json`, `source/pdf-text.txt`; current PDF SHA-256 `cde12eb809ca248cfab3bd5f3d908498085f0b0ca58ce11020a2e12d4cdf8aa5`, 29 pages.

Capture current desktop, tablet and mobile landing-page screenshots and interactions. Record pre-existing differences in unchanged sections, especially S4 video and S5 intro, separately from regressions caused by this work. Source: S1/S4/S14, pp2-6, pp26-27. Evidence: `planning/landing-p0/baseline/` (1440×1000, 768×1024, 390×844); `baseline-report.json`; README observations B01-B13. Ten expected behaviors and one existing conversion defect reproduced; no application fixes made.

Establish typed data for supplied copy, topic count, student/practice/lesson totals, unit labels, pricing, FAQ entries and asset mapping, keeping approval status explicit. A single decision must update every dependent occurrence. Avoid a CMS or broad state-management rewrite. Source: p5, pp18-20, pp24-29. Evidence: planning-only `content-contract.ts` and `content-data.json`, outside `src` and not imported by the app; standalone TypeScript check passed. Business approval is not inferred from supplied draft copy.

Inventory all eight screenshot references, six dialogue clips, two demo prompts, four new feature icons, and optional S12B graphics. Record source, dimensions, suitability, caption/alt text, and whether the asset is supplied or still needed. Source: pp9-15, pp22-23. Evidence: `planning/landing-p0/asset-inventory.json` and `reference-images/`; missing assets remain marked missing, not fabricated.

Track D01-D10 below and the extra engineering questions E01-E04. Unresolved content must not be represented as approved release content. Source: pp27-29. Evidence: `planning/landing-p0/decisions.json` assigns owner/status/evidence/next action. User explicitly deferred D01; all other unconfirmed choices remain unapproved.

Secondary CTA becomes “زيد Zayd للمدارس”; retain outlined styling and Schools navigation. Source: p4, callout 6.
Keep ساعة and clock; subtitle becomes “أسبوعيًا لممارسة الإنجليزية”. Source: p5, callout 1.
Center metric uses the updated 250+ target and subtitle “موضوعًا وموقفًا من الحياة”, subject to D01 consistency confirmation. Preserve document/check icon. Source: p5, callout 2.
Keep ×10 and chart icon; subtitle becomes “لممارسة الإنجليزية”. Preserve Clock → Topics → ×10 right-to-left card order. Source: p5, callout 3.

Preserve right-side logo, RTL order الرئيسية / المنهج / الحياة اليومية / للمدارس / الأسئلة الشائعة, Pricing and Try Zayd buttons, sticky/mobile behavior and anchors. This is a preservation check, not a navbar redesign. Source: pp2-3, callouts 1-4.

Preserve the reference intro: “يدرس الإنجليزية لسنوات / لكن كم يتحدث فعليًا؟” and “المشكلة ليست دائمًا في شرح اللغة، بل في أن كل طالب لا يحصل على الوقت الكافي لممارستها بصورة فردية.” Current repository intro differs; restore this reference text if P0 chooses exact PDF alignment, otherwise record the accepted pre-existing variance. Source: p6, callout 1.
Soft slate/blue container: #F1F5F9 or #EFF6FF, 24px radius, 48px 32px desktop padding; adapt padding on narrow screens. Source: p7, callout 2.
Classroom card on the RIGHT: warm rose border #FECDD3; badge background #FFE4E6 and text #BE123C; warning icons retained. Source: p7, callout 2.

Zayd card on the LEFT: white surface, 2px #0EA5E9 border, soft glow shadow; subtle VS badge between cards. On mobile, stack Classroom then Zayd and position/remove decorative overlap safely. Source: p7, callout 2.

Keep badge “داخل الفصل” and title “معلم واحد ... وعشرات الطلاب”. Body: “مهما بلغت كفاءة المعلم، يظل وقت الحصة محدودًا، مما يقلل فرص ممارسة الإنجليزية بصورة فردية منتظمة لكل طالب.” Source: p7, callout 3.
“وقت محدود للتحدث والقراءة والاستماع”. Source: p7, callout 4.
“فرص أقل للتكرار والمحاولة وتحسين الأداء”. Source: p7, callout 4.
“صعوبة تقديم تغذية راجعة لكل طالب”. Source: p7, callout 4.
Badge “مع زيد”; title “لكل طالب مساحة لممارسة الإنجليزية”. Source: p7, callout 5.
“زيد يعزز دور المعلم، ويمنح لكل طالب فرصًا لممارسة الإنجليزية وفق مستواه وسرعته.” Use زيد, not زايد. Source: p8, callout 6.
“يمارس مهارات اللغة الإنجليزية بتفاعل”. Source: p8, callout 7.
“يتلقى تغذية راجعة فورية لتحسين أدائه”. Source: p8, callout 7.
“يتقدم وفق مستواه مع فرص متكررة للمحاولة”. Source: p8, callout 7.

Preserve badge, grade headline, body and blue tagline. Exact existing intent: “متوافق بالكامل مع المنهج”; “من الأول المتوسط إلى الثالث الثانوي”; “لا يحتاج الطالب إلى منهج جديد. زيد يحوّل ما يدرسه بالفعل إلى تجربة ممارسة شخصية وتفاعلية تساعده على استخدام اللغة، لا مجرد معرفتها.”; “يتعلمها في المنهج... ويمارسها مع زيد.” Source: p9, callouts 2-5.

Include practice-reading-aloud screenshot reference: 31% progress; Reading Passage / Practice Reading / Knowledge Quiz; mic sentence and View Assessment. Suitable for Reading secondary panel and S7 illustration. Source: p10, slide 5.
Map Grammar tab to flashcards: Unit 1 Big Changes, 14% complete, first of eight flip cards. Source: p10, slide 6.
Map Listening tab to audio narration: three steps, waveform, first listen 1 of 2, displayed 00:11/02:14. Source: p10, slide 7.
Map Conversation tab to Roleplay: 3/7 meaningful turns, four remaining, feedback/hint/coaching and mic. Source: p10, slide 8.

Map Form/Meaning/Function tab to grammar reference table for simple past/past progressive with When: Tense, Structure, Example. Source: p11, slide 11.

Include Debate topic-card screenshot for Listening & Discussion. Self-expression mapping remains D03: approved reuse or a supplied dedicated image. All eight tabs must have intentional mappings; do not invent a ninth screenshot from the PDF. Source: p11, slide 12; p28 item 3.

Selected tab changes image/caption; implement tablist/tab/tabpanel semantics, visible focus, selected state, RTL-aware arrow keys and Home/End. Reserve image aspect ratio to avoid jumps; offer zoom/lightbox if screenshot text is otherwise unreadable. This accessibility behavior is the implementation method for the required tabs. Source: pp8-11.
Preserve “كل طالب يتعلم / ويتحدث بطريقته” and character with tablet. Source: p12, callout 1.
“يمنح زيد كل طالب تجربة تفاعلية تتكيف مع مستواه، وتساعده على ممارسة الإنجليزية والتحسن باستمرار.” Source: p12, callout 3.

Place demo entry separately or inside the dedicated widget; preserve access to the existing six demos without letting them erase the specified benefits. Source: pp12-14; observed current renderer.
Pink brain, top-right: “تعلم مخصص” / “يتكيف مع مستوى الطالب واحتياجه.” Source: p12, callout 4.
Purple chat, top-center: “تغذية راجعة فورية” / “ملاحظات ذكية لتحسين الأداء.” Source: p13, callout 5.

Headphones, bottom-right: “تحسين النطق” / “تدريبات لتطوير النطق والطلاقة.” Source: p13, callout 7.
Repeat arrows, bottom-center: “تكرار دون حدود” / “محاولات متكررة حتى الإتقان.” Source: p13, callout 8.
Sprout, bottom-left: “بيئة آمنة للتعلم” / “ممارسة الإنجليزية بثقة دون خوف من الخطأ.” Source: p13, callout 9.

Proposed new title: “تقييم وفق معيار CEFR العالمي”. Proposed body: “قياس دقيق لمستوى الطالب وفق الإطار الأوروبي المشترك للغات (A1–C2).” Confirm copy and accuracy of advertised assessment scope through D05. Source: pp13-14, callout 10.

Proposed new title: “شهادات وشارات إنجاز”. Body: “شهادات إتمام وشارات تحفيزية توثّق تقدم الطالب وإنجازاته في كل مرحلة.” Source: p14, callout 12.
Proposed new title: “نقاط ومكافآت تحفيزية”. Body: “نظام نقاط تنافسي ولوحات شرف تكافئ الطالب على الاستمرارية والتفوق.” Source: p14, callout 13.
“جرّب التحدث والقراءة مع زيد الآن” with “(تجربة تفاعلية مباشرة)”. Source: p12, callout 2.
Inline/in-section widget with two tabs: “تجربة القراءة” and “تجربة التحدث”. Opening existing independent modals alone is insufficient. Source: p12, callout 2.
Display the approved short grade-level English sentence/prompt in LTR; use the chosen one-to-two samples from D04. Keep Arabic instructions RTL. Source: p12; p28 item 4.
Visible mic control labelled “اضغط للتحدث”; ask for microphone only after visitor action; show real recording/waveform state. Source: p12, callout 2.

Show returned pronunciation score and word-by-word assessment highlighting. PDF 92% is an example, not a fixed result. Provide non-color feedback labels so word status remains understandable. Source: p12, callout 2.

Implement idle → requesting mic → recording → processing → feedback → retry, plus denied permission, unsupported recorder, silence, network failure and cancellation. Stop playback/recording when switching tabs, closing or navigating away. These states make the requested real interaction usable. Source: p12; integration requirements.

Keep guest data isolated: no account tokens, no student progress writes, no logged-in redirect. Reuse the existing guest transport or add the smallest guest adapter if schema gaps exist. A typed response is not a substitute for the requested voice interaction. Source: pp12,28; existing public-demo service architecture.

Waveform/live animations reflect actual playback or recording and respect reduced motion. No autoplay voice, fake ongoing recording, permanently fixed score, or success feedback before assessment completes. Source: p12 and referenced slide 2 note on p28.

Use a distinct container with `linear-gradient(135deg, #F0FDFA 0%, #E0F2FE 100%)`, 28px radius, 56px 40px desktop padding and 1px #BAE6FD border; adapt on mobile. Yellow highlighter is not the production border. Source: p15, callout 1.

Add subtle hover-lift plus focus-visible equivalent, audio-preview controls to six scenario cards, one-at-a-time playback, loading/error/replay states and text alternatives. Stop on section/page teardown. Resolve sixth clip via E01. Source: p15, callout 1.

“إتقان الإنجليزية يفتح آفاقًا أوسع للتعليم الجامعي والمعرفة والاستعداد لسوق العمل.” Source: p16, callout 2.
Bottom-right pill: “التطوير المهني”. Source: p17, callout 4.
Bottom-left pill: “التواصل الدولي”. Source: p17, callout 5.

“يتيح زيد فرصًا مكثفة للتحدث بالإنجليزية، تعادل تقريبًا ما قد يحصل عليه خلال 10 سنوات في الفصل التقليدي.” Source: p18, callout 3.
“المقارنة تتعلق بفرص ممارسة الإنجليزية، وليس بسنوات الدراسة.” Keep readable adjacent to the claim. Source: p18, callout 4.

Original 299 SAR, active 199 SAR/year, 33% badge. Source: p20, callout 6.

“أسعار خاصة للمدارس”. Source: p21, callout 4.

“اطلب عرضًا لمدرستك”, keeping the quote/contact flow and left arrow. Source: p22, callout 7.

Render three clearly differentiated informational cards in Admin → Teacher → Student RTL order; stack in the same reading order on mobile. Add approved imagery only if selected under D08. Do not add fake working Nudge/Redeem buttons to a marketing card. Source: pp22-23; pp28-29 item 8.
Preserve FAQ badge and “كل ما تحتاج معرفته قبل البدء”. Source: p24, callout 1.

Record the chosen behavior. Source: pp24-26.

Search rendered content and source data for old topic counts, prices, discount claims, impact figures, تساوي, old scenario labels and old FAQ usage claims. Review hits contextually; unrelated student-app content is not automatically part of this landing update.

Compare S1 navigation, S4 video, unchanged hero/curriculum/scenario/future/impact elements, teacher artwork and S14 CTA/footer against the captured baseline and accepted variances. Check anchors and sticky offsets after new sections change heights.
